Estimations ÷ visiteurs de la page d'acc: Valuations ÷ visitors to the funnel home page, over the exact days selected (sum of the days). Valuation = user who triggered the trade-in request (GA4 event tradein_request). Same rate in the funnel, the network ranking and the Conversion curve. The change is a difference in percentage points.
Rang du taux de conversion du site parmi: Rank of the site's conversion rate among all sites in the network, over the same period and with the same definition. The median is the rate of the site in the middle of the ranking.
Six étapes, en utilisateurs actifs GA4 p: Six steps, in GA4 active users per day, added up over the period: home (page_category = home page), version, mileage, contact details, dealership (step_name parameter), then valuation (tradein_request event). Percentages are relative to home page visitors.
Visiteurs de l'accueil menés jusqu'à l'e: Home page visitors taken through to the valuation · {0}
100 % moins le taux de conversion : part: 100% minus the conversion rate: share of home page visitors who do not reach the valuation.
Contribution à l'évolution des estimatio: Contribution to the change in valuations
Pourquoi les estimations (étape finale d: Why valuations (the last funnel step) changed between the two periods: effect of the audience (home page visitors), then of each funnel step. Each effect is the share of the gap attributed by logarithmic decomposition; their sum gives back exactly the gap. Truncated axis: only the change bars should be read.
Calculées chaque nuit sur les 7 derniers: Computed every night on the last 7 days of data, compared with the previous 28 days: drop in trade-in site sessions, drop in conversion rate, leak at a funnel step, delayed data. Thresholds are set here; they apply to the next analysis.
Leads valides du back-office, cumulés de: Valid back-office leads, cumulated since 1 January, against each site's annual target. “Expected to date” follows last year's seasonality (share of the year already elapsed); the projection extends the pace of the last 90 days over the rest of the year, like the Lead Management forecast.
Ce qui explique une cassure de courbe :: What explains a break in a curve: campaign launched, button added, V2 switchover, commercial offer, tagging change. Each event appears as an orange marker on the “Sessions by channel” and “Conversion per day” curves, and feeds the presentations analysis.
Chaque courbe est une année, mois par mo: Each curve is one year, month by month, based on the deep GA4 history (since 2022 for sessions, since 2024 for valuations). The current month, being incomplete, is not plotted.
Mois par mois · site de reprise · le moi: Month by month · trade-in site · the current month is not plotted
L'historique mensuel arrive avec le proc: The monthly history arrives with the next data refresh.
Top 20 des couples source / médium × cam: Top 20 source / medium × campaign pairs for each month, with sessions, engagement and valuations triggered (tradein_request event). “Campaign” groups by the campaign name extracted from the tagging (CN~…).
Site de reprise · top 20 par mois · mois: Trade-in site · top 20 per month · months covered by the period
Les campagnes et UTM arrivent avec le pr: Campaigns and UTM arrive with the next data refresh.
Part des sessions « engagées » (GA4 : pl: Share of “engaged” sessions (GA4: more than 10 seconds, a conversion or at least 2 page views) by acquisition channel, compared with the site average and the comparison period. A high-volume channel with low engagement brings poorly qualified traffic.
Sessions engagées ÷ sessions · site de r: Engaged sessions ÷ sessions · trade-in site · months covered by the period
Les sessions engagées par canal arrivent: Engaged sessions by channel arrive with the next data refresh.
Pour chaque appareil ou canal d'acquisit: For each device or acquisition channel (Paid, Organic…): share of visitors (under each percentage: number of users who reached the step) who move from one step to the next (active users, months covered by the period). Green / red: above / below the site average by at least 2 points on the step.
Passage d'une étape à la suivante · mois: Move from one step to the next · months covered by the period
L'entonnoir par appareil et par canal ar: The funnel by device and by channel arrives with the next data refresh.
Site parent · top 6 par sessions · cliqu: Parent site · top 6 by sessions · click a header to sort
Sessions GA4 du site parent (pas de l'ou: GA4 sessions of the parent site (not the trade-in tool) per day, split by GA4 default channel group (Paid Search, Organic Search, Direct...). The first four channels are shown; click a name to isolate it.
Pour chaque jour : estimations ÷ visiteu: For each day: valuations ÷ funnel home page visitors. Thick line = 7-day rolling average (sum of valuations ÷ sum of visitors over 7 days), light line = the day, dotted = previous period. The red marker shows the V2 switchover date when a single V2 site is selected.
La conversion quotidienne n'est pas enco: Daily conversion is not yet available for this period: it appears after the next data refresh.
Mêmes jours exacts et même définition qu: Same exact days and same definition as everywhere in the dashboard (valuations ÷ home page visitors, sum of the days). Two modes. “My dates” (default) compares the period chosen at the top with the comparison period, as everywhere; a warning appears when a window contains days of the other journey. “Around the switchover” compares the 7, 14 or 28 days before the site's switchover with all days since the switchover. Volumes are per-day averages because the windows do not have the same length. Several sites: each site keeps its own switchover dates, daily volumes are added up.
Volume faible (moins de 300 visiteurs su: Low volume (fewer than 300 visitors in one of the periods): indicative trend.
Aucun site V2 avec assez de recul dans l: No V2 site with enough history in the selection. The comparison is published 7 days after a site's switchover, with 4 weeks of reference before.
Total = tous appareils confondus (sessio: Total = all devices combined (sessions and conversions added up, rate recalculated). Rate = sessions that triggered the valuation request ÷ sessions of the channel and device. The denominator is therefore sessions: this measure differs from the journey conversion rate (valuations ÷ home page visitors) and is used to compare channels with each other.
Taux de conversion croisé · delta vs pér: Cross conversion rate · delta vs previous period
Moyenne par jour de la semaine sur la pé: Average per day of the week over the period (trade-in tool sessions), breakdown of browsers and of new / returning visitors in sessions. Source: GA4.
Jour de semaine, navigateurs et type de: Day of the week, browsers and visitor type
Données Search Console de la propriété d: Search Console data for the site's property. CTR = clicks ÷ impressions; average position weighted by impressions. The monthly detail is exact; the day-by-day view (clicks, impressions) is only plotted over 60 days or less, as position is only stored by month.
